title: Equal-dimensional finite vector spaces are linearly isomorphic
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $V,W$ be finite-dimensional $k$-vector spaces [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace]. If $\dim_k V=\dim_k W$ [def-weil-vector-space-dimension], then there exists a bijective $k$-linear map $V\to W$ (a linear isomorphism).
